methodology: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING ON) Execution Time, median over 15 iters/query, medians over queries; DISTINCT vectors seeded via Python COPY (never the non-correlated string_agg InitPlan idiom — see ADR 0012).

uniform_random.note: IVFFlat worst case (no cluster structure) — recall low for BOTH; theodb decisively faster.

phase0_profile.note: Scan hot-loop compute (N=65000, dim=128), portable SSE2 build, mean over 60 iters.

hotloop_microbench.note: benchmarks/micro/simd_hotloop_bench.rs, N=65000 dim=128, scalar decode+distance vs fused AVX2+FMA.
